item.title: "It's all of us against apathy, entropy, and loss of art" - Stop Killing Games has reached the EU Parliament, but what happens now?
item.description: An interview with Stop Killing Games advocate and spokesperson Josh Strfye Hayes about the future of the movement now it's visited EU parliament.

item.title: "Most North Americans and Europeans don't understand the frustrating feeling of waiting 10 minutes to find a match" - Bungie steps into help Marathon players from "isolated geographical regions"
item.description: Bungie has implemented a change to improve matchmaking for Marathon players in "isolated geographical regions".

item.title: Nintendo reportedly lowers Switch 2 production
item.description: Nintendo's Switch 2 got off to a roaring start but demand has started to sag, particularly in the US. Where are the big games to reverse this?

item.title: Super Mario Galaxy Movie age-rating accidentally confirms a 20-year-old fan theory
item.description: A ratings board listing for Nintendo's upcoming Super Mario Galaxy Movie may have just let slip a pretty major plot point.

item.title: High on Life 2's Switch 2 release delayed "to better meet not only our high standards for gaming, but yours as well"
item.description: High on Life 2, the sequel to the crude and comedic FPS from Squanch Games, has had its Switch 2 release delayed by a couple of months.

item.title: Bungie is shifting Marathon's endgame content around, so you won't have to pick between ranked or Cryo Archive this weekend
item.description: Bungie has shifted the weekly schedule of Cryo Archive and Ranked modes, so one is always available week-round.

item.title: Pokémon Pokopia's second limited-time event adds Sableye in late April, but you can already cheat your way into it
item.description: Pokémon Pokopia's second limited-time event is adding Sableye to the game, and you can access it early.

item.title: Sony shuts down Dark Outlaw Games and downsizes mobile games development as PlayStation continues to rethink plans
item.description: Sony-owned studio Dark Outlaw Games is being closed, and around 50 people are being laid off across SIE's mobile game teams.

item.title: Crimson Desert's Pearl Abyss regains investor confidence as it continues to move beyond launch day woes
item.description: After a rocky start, Pearl Abyss and Crimson Desert are regaining some lost confidence from investors.

item.title: PlayStation Plus Essential headliner game for April leaks
item.description: One of the games expected to arrive along with April 2026's PS Plus Essential lineup has leaked ahead of schedule.

item.title: Half-Life 2 writer Erik Wolpaw says some people at Valve are looking at AI tools, but he's not "worried about AI taking over creative writing" anytime soon
item.description: Half-Life 2: Episode 1 & 2 and Portal co-writer Erik Wolpaw has commented on Valve's current stance regarding AI tools.

item.title: Peter Molyneux's Fable and Black & White mash-up Masters of Albion is getting a closed beta, but you'll have to be quick if you want to get involved
item.description: Peter Molyneux's latest game, Masters of Albion, is almost here. First, though, it's getting a closed beta test, but registration is closing very soon.

item.title: Marathon may have sold roughly 1.2m copies worldwide, with the majority on Steam rather than PlayStation, according to analyst estimates
item.description: Video game analyst Rhys Elliot from Alinea Analytics has posted estimated player counts for Marathon, including platform split and around 1.2m copies sold.

item.title: After Tekken 8 Season 3 led to a Mostly Negative rating on Steam, Bandai Namco is working on an "emergency patch" to win fans back
item.description: Bandai Namco will set live an "emergency patch" in response to harsh feedback to its season 3 update.

item.title: Pokémon Champions is releasing on Nintendo Switch consoles in early April, but its "free-to-start" package raises some questions about its pricing model
item.description: Pokémon Champions is finally arriving in April to Nintendo Switch consoles, but its "free-to-start" model seems limiting and confusing.
